relevant_findings.finding: Closet shelving uses Opening Count quantification method
relevant_findings.impact: Primary UOM is EA (openings by tier S/M/L/XL), not SF

relevant_findings.finding: NC closet shelving is typically factory-primed MDF or bare wood
relevant_findings.impact: Substrate state drives primer task inclusion

relevant_findings.finding: Bare wood requires spray_rolloff to work primer into grain
relevant_findings.impact: Application method conditional on substrate state

relevant_findings.finding: MDF edges require solvent-based sealer to prevent fiber raise
relevant_findings.impact: Edge seal task conditional on bare MDF

relevant_findings.finding: Closet shelving triggers COMP_CLOSET_SHELVING (1.5x) modifier on adjacent wall/ceiling specs
relevant_findings.impact: This spec causes modifier on other specs, does not receive it

condition_drivers.effect: SS_BARE requires primer coat; SS_PRIMED_FACTORY skips primer
spray_rolloff required for SS_BARE to work primer into grain
Detail level affects complexity and edge work

quality_differences.description: Minimal quality. Basic coverage, visible brush marks acceptable. 1 finish coat.
Standard quality. Even coverage, light brush marks acceptable. 2 finish coats.
Premium quality. Smooth finish, minimal imperfections. 2 finish coats with sanding between.
Superior quality. Near-flawless finish. 2-3 finish coats with thorough sanding between.

failure_modes.cause: Water-based primer on unsealed MDF edges
failure_modes.prevention: Solvent-based edge sealer before latex primer

failure_modes.mode: Poor primer adhesion on bare wood
failure_modes.cause: Spray without rolloff leaves primer on surface, not in grain
Over-application on shelf edges and backs

notes_for_materials_manager: MDF edge sealer required for SS_BARE MDF (solvent-based)
Standard acrylic enamel sufficient for QT2-QT3
Primer selection based on substrate state per Millwork Doctrine
notes_for_sop_librarian: Use Opening Count as quantity driver, not SF
Include edge seal task conditional on bare MDF
Application method task variants: brush_roll, spray, spray_rolloff
Keep modules minimal — this is a simple spec
notes_for_estimation_engineer: Apply depth, detail, access modifiers from BuiltIns Quantification System
No COMP_CLOSET_SHELVING modifier on this spec — it causes that modifier on others

adjacency_notes: Adjacent to wall_field at back of shelves (linear edge)
Shelves typically different finish from walls (white/neutral vs wall color)
No cut-in required — shelf edge meets wall, caulk seals gap

zones.notes: Drop cloth under closet opening for drips. Minimal protection needed — closet floors often unfinished in NC.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Shelf back meets wall. Gap caulked during prep. No cut-in at paint time.

affected_conditions.notes: Floor protection only when finished floors present. NC often has subfloor.

affected_conditions.modifier_notes: Tight closet access may slow production
affected_conditions.notes: ACCESS modifier from BuiltIns Quantification System handles this

valid_input_states.rationale: NC closet shelving is either bare wood/MDF or factory-primed

output_state.rationale: Output state determined by sheen configuration. Satin is default.

adjacent_state_protection_analysis.rationale: Shelf-to-wall junction is caulked gap, no overspray risk with brush_roll. Spray application rare for installed closet shelves.

assumptions.note: Closet floors often subfloor in NC; protection conditional on floor_type
